name: Early Blight
treatment: Remove affected leaves and improve air circulation.
prevention: Avoid overhead watering and maintain appropriate plant spacing.

name: Bacterial Leaf Spot
treatment: Remove affected material and improve sanitation.
prevention: Use clean planting material and avoid unnecessary leaf wetness.

name: Mosaic Virus
treatment: Remove infected plants where appropriate and manage vectors.
prevention: Use healthy planting material and monitor insect vectors.

name: Leaf Curl Virus
treatment: Remove severely affected plants where appropriate and manage vectors.
prevention: Use healthy plants and monitor vector populations.

name: Late Blight
treatment: Remove infected plant material and follow appropriate crop protection guidance.
prevention: Use healthy planting material and avoid prolonged leaf wetness.

name: Bacterial Wilt
treatment: Remove severely affected plants and maintain field sanitation.
prevention: Use healthy planting material and crop rotation where appropriate.

name: Powdery Mildew
treatment: Remove heavily affected material and improve field ventilation.
prevention: Maintain suitable spacing and monitor crop conditions.

name: Aphid Infestation
treatment: Use appropriate integrated pest management practices.
prevention: Monitor crops regularly and encourage beneficial insects.

name: Stem Borer
treatment: Remove severely affected material and use integrated pest management.
prevention: Monitor fields and maintain appropriate crop management.

name: Northern Leaf Blight
treatment: Remove severely affected material and use appropriate disease management.
prevention: Use resistant varieties where available and maintain field sanitation.
